title: Sandbox deploy executor
description: Builds the project image locally with podman, pushes it to the container registry, imports it into the sandbox namespace, and rolls out the deployment.

sandboxProject.description: The OpenShift namespace to deploy the sandbox into.

registry.description: Container registry the sandbox image is published to (e.g. ghcr.io/my-org).

database.description: Provision a shared sandbox database of this type before deploying. 'postgres' uses the CloudNativePG operator when available and falls back to the plain Deployment otherwise.

appType.description: Application type. Detected from the project configuration when omitted.

imageTag.description: Image tag pushed and imported into the namespace imagestream.

skipBuild.description: Skip the nx build + podman build steps and reuse the already-built image (resume a partial deploy).

skipPush.description: Skip the registry login + push and reuse the already-pushed image (resume from the import step).

deployBackend.description: For a frontend: deploy each paired backend (its own sandbox target) first, so proxied /api calls work. Off by default; without it, a missing backend is warned about, not deployed.

importRetries.description: How many times to retry oc import-image (absorbs the 409 from oc tag's async reconcile).

registerDirectory.description: After a successful rollout, register the service in the ADSP directory under the tenant's namespace (register-once — skips if the entry already exists). Only applies to node and dotnet app types. Requires an active adsp login with the directory-admin role.

dockerfile.description: Path to the container build file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to .openshift/<project>/Dockerfile, falling back to .openshift/<project>/Containerfile. Set this when the file lives elsewhere -- e.g. a repository-root Dockerfile, which the OpenShift container-contract preflight and the Government Developer Station both look for.
